movie: Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie
review:
I watched it without really knowing what it was about, and I enjoyed it quite a lot. It features a good dose of humor, a touch of nostalgia, and plenty of references, with *Back to the Future* being the primary target.

The film is shot in a mockumentary style and executes it very well, incorporating fourth-wall breaks and various moments that leave you impressed, wondering how they pulled it off.

The blend of all these elements makes for a highly entertaining movie and a recommendation to anyone who enjoys the mockumentary style and/or is a fan of *Back to the Future*.
